title: docker inspect
definition: A diagnostic CLI command that returns low-level, highly detailed JSON metadata about Docker objects (containers, images, networks, or volumes).
simpleExplanation: The ultimate X-Ray vision tool. It spits out a massive wall of JSON text telling you every single technical detail about a container, from its IP address to its mapped volumes.
realWorldExample: Two containers on a custom network cannot communicate. A DevOps engineer runs `docker inspect network my-net`. The JSON output reveals that one of the containers was accidentally connected to the wrong subnet.

basic: What format does the `docker inspect` command output its data in?
intermediate: How can you extract just the IP Address from the massive wall of text `docker inspect` produces without reading the whole thing?

answers.question: How to extract specific data?
answers.answer: Using the `--format` flag (which uses Go templates). For example: `docker inspect -f '{{range.NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' my-container`.
